scope: Connected shoot identity family only; broader preserved CI batch remains separately pending review. Source navigation does not count whole-file audit coverage.

lenses.source_trace: Four terminal producers own stable purpose-derived seeds; carry identity through stored terminal branch, leaves, sampling and specimen selection. Native positions cannot identify shoots.
Seed owns deterministic derivation; no existing shoot-specific owner. Reuse Seed, introduce one opaque shoot ID at existing identity owner.
Only actual terminal shoot producers attach an ID; ordinary axes have no foliage. No decoded/public admission or compatibility fallback.
Retain native geometry and per-purpose RNG arithmetic. Identity derives from seed before numerical geometry; append copies it only to final segment.
Foliage membership and shoot identity share Option<TreeShootId>; remove consumer reconstruction from depth and coordinates. Wood curve termination remains independent.
Identity belongs to existing tree geometry leaf identity module; skeleton producer and all leaf consumers import one owner.
Remove coordinate-derived shoot_identity API entirely. No second ID/count/cache authority; geometry fingerprints remain native boundary and must consume ID losslessly.

Intentional random realization change: old native float bits salted leaf RNG. Shoot counts, wood positions, leaf ordinal/counts, card arithmetic and draw purposes remain. Existing snapshot/envelope/assets require hosted regeneration and acceptance.
Some shoot identity means foliage-bearing terminal segment; None means no leaf flush. Do not add a Boolean plus optional identity. is_limb_tip retained solely for wood curve geometry.
Identity equality/order/hash/copy/debug are word semantics and derive directly. Seed derivation and native RNG/hash adaptation remain explicit.
Distinguish shoot identity from source seed and grouping indices; no per-branch or root identity needed. Existing groups are not unique per shoot.
Reuse exact existing visual.tree.shoot-identity purpose in its sole owner. No prose branching or wire changes.
Eliminate f32 bit fields from identity. u64 confined to opaque ID and native hash boundary. Existing numeric fixtures adapt to checked owner without new cases/assertions.

acceptance: Existing shrub population/reorder, tree leaf/sampling, specimen envelope and retained scene checks pass on hosted Linux
Existing exporter regenerates envelope/assets with provenance; no platform-specific expectations or weakened assertions
Independent Code/Rule/Comment and fresh scoped all13 source reviews
Full hosted quality run accepted before merge checkpoint
limits: Observed platform count difference alone does not prove every geometry failure is caused by IDs
